entries.en: Is it not too early for champagne?
entries.ro: Nu e prea devreme pentru șampanie?

entries.en: But if it helps you calm down…
entries.ro: Dar dacă te ajută să te calmezi…

entries.en: No thanks. My hands are fine.
[Accept drink] Sure, might clear my head.
No need. My hands are fine.
entries.ro: Nu e nevoie. Mâinile mi-s bine.

entries.en: Hmph, what is strange is that this has only happened now.
entries.ro: Hmph, ciudat e că s-a întâmplat abia acum.

entries.en: And I have no answer for her.
entries.en_m: And I have no answer for him.
entries.ro: Și n-am niciun răspuns pentru ea.
entries.ro_m: Și n-am niciun răspuns pentru el.

entries.en: You will lose your hearing next. Then your sight.
[Finish champagne] Well, no time to lose, then.
entries.ro: [Termină șampania] Păi, nu e timp de pierdut, atunci.

entries.en: Not here, not without proper equipment.
entries.ro: Nu aici, nu fără echipamentul potrivit.

entries.en: Well, no time to waste, then.
entries.ro: Păi, nu e timp de pierdut, atunci.

entries.en_m: Heh, might help clear my head.

entries.en: I might beg to differ, V.
entries.ro: Aș zice că nu sunt de acord, V.

entries.en: Does anyone else have trembling hands?
Rest of me's up to scratch, too.
She faded out in the car.
entries.en_m: He faded out in the car.

entries.en: Your central nervous system is a shambles.
To be honest, it's a miracle you can still walk.
entries.ro: Sincer, e un miracol că mai poți merge.

entries.en: Her central nervous system is a shambles.
entries.en_m: His central nervous system is a shambles.
entries.ro: Sistemul ei nervos central e un dezastru.
entries.ro_m: Sistemul lui nervos central e un dezastru.

entries.en: Honestly, it's a miracle she can still walk.
entries.en_m: Honestly, it's a miracle he can still walk.
entries.ro: Sincer, e un miracol că mai poate merge.

entries.en: Watch your tone, or it is you who will find it hard to walk.
entries.ro: Mai bine ai grijă la ton, că ajungi tu să ai probleme să mergi.

entries.en: Is your nervous system a shambles, too?
entries.ro: Și sistemul tău nervos e varză?

entries.en: Once Yorinobu has been dealt with, we shall attend to your needs.
entries.ro: După ce terminăm cu Yorinobu, ne ocupăm și de nevoile tale.
